description: This file defines the LeavePeriod class in the OrangeHRM Leave module, which represents a period with start and end dates for leave management. It provides getters and setters for these dates and methods to retrieve formatted date strings, utilizing a date helper trait.

classes.name: LeavePeriod
classes.description: A data transfer object defining a leave period with start and end dates, including methods for retrieving and setting these dates and formatting them.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a LeavePeriod with optional start and end DateTime objects.

methods.name: getYmdStartDate
methods.description: Returns the start date formatted as a string in YMD format.

methods.name: getYmdEndDate
methods.description: Returns the end date formatted as a string in YMD format.
